kind: Analyst-constructed illustration, not a new participant experiment or open-ended discovery claim.
assumptions: Independent fair attributes; a unit loss if unprotected failure occurs; protection costs 3/10 and perfectly prevents loss. Effectiveness and costs are stipulated.
observation_boundary: Population pairwise projections agree. Same observation law follows for separate independent-case samples of those projections with linkage omitted; do not infer equality of every finite-sample statistic collected on the same linked cohort.
null_world: Failure is an independent fair bit.
interpretation: An informative joint distinction may be generated by recombining existing observations even when every separate marginal check is uninformative. Testing that new distinction is necessary because the same candidate can harm in the indistinguishable-at-the-old-interface world.
limits: Raw attributes and finite expansion grammar supplied by analyst.
Exact model arithmetic, not real-world causal evidence.
Records preserving full joint outcomes distinguish the worlds.
There is no guarantee against every omitted feature or unknown future purpose.
